checks.text: With no entries, the page shows the heading "Mood Tracker", the text "No moods logged yet", and the streak counter "Streak: 0 days".

Selecting "Calm" in the select labelled "Mood", typing "Good night" in the field labelled "Note", and clicking the button "Log mood" adds a list item containing "Calm" and "Good night"; the streak counter updates to "Streak: 1 days" and "No moods logged yet" is gone.

After logging "Calm" for today, selecting "Anxious" in the select labelled "Mood" and clicking "Log mood" again adds a second list item containing "Anxious"; the streak counter remains "Streak: 1 days" because both logs are for the same day.
Clicking "Log mood" with the select labelled "Mood" set to the default empty option adds no list item and shows the message "Select a mood".
The heatmap section displays a grid of squares for the last 7 days; the square for today is filled with the color associated with the last logged mood "Anxious", and the other 6 squares are empty.
The trend chart section displays an SVG line chart with a single point at the y-axis value corresponding to "Anxious" (value 2 on a 1-5 scale) for today's x-axis position.
Clicking the button "Delete Calm" removes the first list item, leaving only the item with "Anxious"; the streak counter remains "Streak: 1 days".
After logging "Calm" for today, reloading the page still shows the list item with "Calm", the streak counter "Streak: 1 days", and the heatmap square for today filled.
